title: Version Intelligence Sync v8 Markdown Dashboard
description:
# Version Intelligence Sync v6

## How to Setup
1. Open the schedule trigger and configure workflow inputs for vault IDs and lookup paths.
2. Confirm vault token scopes for RUM APIs, events ingest, cluster version API, and lookup uploads.
3. Run one manual execution and verify upload task row counts.

## Runtime Collection Coverage
- SaaS version from cluster version API
- OneAgent distribution from host installerVersion
- ActiveGate distribution from startup log parsing
- Operator state from Kubernetes inventory presence
- EdgeConnect fallback row until runtime source validation is completed

## Data Targets
- Release lookup: /lookups/dt_component_release_status
- Runtime lookup: /lookups/dt_component_runtime_versions

## Troubleshooting
- If release rows are unavailable, validate docs sitemap accessibility.
- If runtime uploads fail, validate lookup upload permissions and parse pattern compatibility.
- If Operator is not_configured, Kubernetes cluster inventory is absent in this tenant.

## v6 Markdown Dashboard Output
This workflow updates markdown-only release dashboard cards each run, including top-level update timestamp.

collect_activegate_runtime_distribution.description: Collect ActiveGate runtime version distribution from host logs.

input.query: fetch logs, from:now()-24h | filter contains(content, "Dynatrace ActiveGate started.") | filter isNotNull(host.name) | parse content, "LD '(' LD:activegate_version ')' LD" | filter isNotNull(activegate_version) | summarize running_count = countDistinct(host.name), by: { activegate_version } | sort activegate_version desc

collect_activegate_runtime_distribution.name: collect_activegate_runtime_distribution

collect_oneagent_runtime_distribution.description: Collect OneAgent runtime version distribution from host telemetry.

input.query: fetch dt.entity.host | filter isNotNull(installerVersion) | summarize hosts = count(), by: {installerVersion} | sort installerVersion desc
